mentions.name: Just Chess Puzzles
mentions.description: An App Store chess puzzle app offering 100,000 rated chess puzzles that work fully offline, similar to chess.com or lichess puzzle modes. Its unique "play it out" mode lets players finish the game against a chess engine of matching difficulty. It provides 20 free puzzles per day or a $5 lifetime purchase for unlimited puzzles and features.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just released my 2nd app to the App Store: Just Chess Puzzles

It’s as simple as it sounds: 100,000 chess puzzles, all offline, rated (just like chess.com or lichess puzzle modes)
